thread:
dani-cs: Quick async standup -- handoff for Kestrel renewal

What I did: collected logs from customer webhook, confirmed 412/429 retry pattern, emailed legal for contract wording question.
Blockers: need SLO clarification for throttled responses so we can recommend Dedicated plan; renewal call scheduled Tues.
Today: prepare short summary for renewals call, ping eng for ETA on fix, ask AE to confirm names on renewal call.

leo-eng: Thanks. Can you paste the error sample? I can look for root cause today.

dani-cs: Sure — pasted below.

```
2026-03-16T09:12:43Z ERROR request_id=abc123 status=429 "rate exceeded" path=/v1/embeddings
customer_retry_after=120
```

leo-eng: Hmm looks like client triggered retry storms. Two quick asks: 1) do they use parallel clients? 2) what model/route? If it's hosted model 'redwood-embed-3', we can suggest prefix caching.

dani-cs: They're on hosted, route: embeddings/fast, model: redwood-embed-3. They've got a custom retry wrapper in app code.

maya-pm: Re SLOs — we should be explicit in the renewal doc: 99.5% p99 latency and request-level rate limits. @sam-ae can you confirm if discounts depend on hitting those targets?

sam-ae: I can confirm discounts tied to committed qps. I'll have numbers by EOD. For the call, include proposed Dedicated burst capacity numbers.

anu-support: I flagged the account for priority; I've opened a ticket to enable per-customer rate-limiting on the edge (internal ticket: EDGE-4721). Will update when toggled.

leo-eng: I can drop a small mitigation this afternoon — add early-503 backoff when client retry header missing. Quick PR inbound. @dani-cs can you share a minimal repro (curl) I can test against staging?

dani-cs: Repro below. It's a simple loop with 5 concurrent curl requests hitting the embeddings endpoint.

```
for i in {1..5}; do 
  curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"test"}' &
 done; wait
```

leo-eng: thanks — I'll run it and post results. If staging reproduces, PR target by 6pm PT.

sam-ae: For renewal meeting agenda: 1) outage summary 2) proposed Dedicated config 3) next steps & credits. I'll draft and share.

deploy-bot: NOTE: canary deploy scheduled for 2026-03-16T18:00:00Z — will auto-rollback on errors.

dani-cs: Great, thanks everyone. If we get the mitigation in and edge toggle, I'll mark blocker cleared and update the renewals doc.

leo-eng: :thumbsup: will update thread when PR is merged.

anu-support: Follow-up: EDGE-4721 created, assignee @anu-support.

maya-pm: Thanks — I'll sync the renewal slide deck with these talking points.
